title: Resetting your password
text: To reset your passcode, open the self-service portal and choose Forgot. A new login credentials must have 14 characters. Your login credentials expires every 90 days. See the related pages for more information. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Connecting to the VPN
text: Add the remote access client client from the software centre. Sign in with your company account and approve the phone prompt. The VPN is required to reach internal sites from home. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear. This policy applies to all locations.

title: Printer problems
text: If the copier shows an error, switch it off for 30 seconds. Print jobs are released by tapping your badge on the print device. Toner is replaced by the office team, not by IT. This page was last reviewed this year. This policy applies to all locations.

title: Email storage limits
text: Each mailbox has a limit of 50 GB. When the email is 90 percent full you get a warning. Archive old messages to free space in your Outlook. Local rules may add further details. See the related pages for more information.

title: Requesting new software
text: Open a support request in the service portal to request software. Licensed software needs approval from your manager. Free tools from the software centre can be installed directly. This policy applies to all locations. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Laptop replacement
text: A work machine is replaced every 4 years. Damaged work machine repairs are booked through a support request. Return the old computer within 2 weeks of receiving the new one. Local rules may add further details. This policy applies to all locations.

title: Wi-Fi access
text: Staff connect to the corporate wireless network with their company account. Guests use the guest internet connection; the code changes every week. Personal phones must use the guest wifi. Local rules may add further details. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Multi-factor authentication
text: Multi-factor authentication uses the authenticator app on your phone. If you change phone, open a help desk case to move MFA. Backup codes can be printed from the security page. Local rules may add further details. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Reporting phishing
text: Forward suspicious email messages to the security team with the Report button. Never click links in unexpected inbox messages. Security replies within one business day. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear. This policy applies to all locations.

title: Shared drives
text: Team folders live on the shared drive and are backed up every night. Access to a shared drive is requested through a ticket. Files deleted in the last 30 days can be restored. Local rules may add further details. See the related pages for more information.

title: Video conferencing
text: Meetings use the company video platform, which supports 300 participants. Recordings are kept for 60 days. Use a headset to reduce echo in meetings. Local rules may add further details. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Mobile phones
text: Company phones are managed with the device management app. Lost phones must be reported within 24 hours through a ticket. Personal phones can access Outlook after installing the management app. This page was last reviewed this year. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Software centre
text: The software centre lists approved applications. Most tools set up in a few minutes. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear. Local rules may add further details.

title: Office printers map
text: A map of every printer is on the intranet. Colour printing is available on floor 3. This policy applies to all locations. Local rules may add further details.

title: Data classification
text: Documents are classified as public, internal or confidential. Label every file. See the related pages for more information. Local rules may add further details.

title: Clean desk policy
text: Lock your screen when you leave your desk. Store papers in locked drawers. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear. See the related pages for more information.

title: Accessibility tools
text: Screen readers and magnifiers can be requested through a help desk case. This page was last reviewed this year. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Monitors and docking stations
text: Each desk has a docking station and two monitors. Local rules may add further details. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Collaboration tools
text: Use the team chat for quick questions and mailbox for formal messages. This policy applies to all locations. This page was last reviewed this year.

title: IT service hours
text: The help desk is open from 7am to 7pm on working days. Local rules may add further details. This page was last reviewed this year.

title: Security training
text: Every user completes security awareness training once a year. This page was last reviewed this year. See the related pages for more information.

title: Backup policy
text: Laptops are not backed up automatically. Store work files on the shared drive. This page was last reviewed this year. See the related pages for more information.

title: Encryption
text: Every laptop is encrypted. Never disable encryption. This page was last reviewed this year. This policy applies to all locations.

title: Personal devices policy
text: Personal devices may not connect to the internal network. This policy applies to all locations. Local rules may add further details.

title: Software licences
text: Licences are assigned per user and reviewed every quarter. Local rules may add further details. This page was last reviewed this year.

title: Browser support
text: Use the latest version of a supported browser for internal sites. This policy applies to all locations. This page was last reviewed this year.

title: Keyboard and mouse
text: Replacement keyboards and mice are available from the IT kiosk. This policy applies to all locations. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Conference room screens
text: Every meeting room has a wireless screen-sharing device. See the related pages for more information. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Developer tools
text: Developers request admin rights through a help desk case with manager approval. This policy applies to all locations. Local rules may add further details.

title: Cloud storage
text: Personal cloud storage services are blocked. Use the company file storage instead. See the related pages for more information. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Out of office replies
text: Set an automatic reply in your email when you are away. This policy applies to all locations. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.

title: Hardware disposal
text: Old devices are wiped and recycled by IT. Never throw them away. This policy applies to all locations. Contact the help desk if anything is unclear.
